editorial.blurb: Tasty China is a family-owned spot offering reliable Chinese-American comfort food at budget-friendly prices, with new management breathing fresh energy into the kitchen.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead for takeout—orders come ready on time—and ask about the Tuesday lunch special (Kung Pao at $7.95) if you're watching your budget, though note it doesn't include an egg roll like regular lunch specials do.
